### God's Silent Presence
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/gods-silent-presence
Passage: 1 Kings 19:12-13
Points:
- Believers who witness dramatic miracles can still struggle to perceive God in quiet, ordinary times.
- Although Elijah witnessed fierce wind, an earthquake, and fire, the Lord was not in the cataclysmic displays.
- The Lord spoke instead through a low whisper to assure Elijah of His presence.
- God frequently accomplishes extraordinary plans through silent, unremarkable daily decisions rather than visible signs.

### Lean In A Little Closer
Author: Joan Walker Hahn
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-february-14-2017.html
Passage: 1 Kings 19:12
Points:
- Spiritual highs can quickly be followed by overwhelming feelings of exhaustion, fear, and defeat.
- God chose to bypass violent wind, earthquakes, and fire, speaking instead in a gentle whisper.
- God often whispers to draw us near so we listen attentively to His voice.
- Bringing our fatigue to the Lord in stillness allows Him to revive us and provide renewed direction.
